note: Examples for the schema, not game content. A dialogue is what one kind of person says to the player, in a voice, with the replies the player may give. {speaker.name} is the one speaking.

lines.text: Sit. There is bread, and the fire has not quite given up on us. Tell me the day, or do not; I can read most of it off your boots.

replies.text: Tell {speaker.them} the day, all of it.
Sit, and say nothing, and eat.

lines.text: The hurdles have moved again. I saw it from the well. I am not saying anything about it. I am saying I saw it.

replies.text: Say you saw it too, and that it will keep.
Say it is your field and you will see to it.

lines.text: {speaker.name} does not look up from the mending. "The steward's cart went by twice today. He does not go by twice for nothing."

replies.text: Say you have a plan for it.
Say you do not know what you will do.
Say nothing, and listen to the needle.

lines.text: The little one asked today whether the field would be theirs. I said it would. I would like that to be true, is all.
